integrity: Proof self-contained apart from standard finite-dimensional operator/nuclear duality and elementary fidelity variational identity, both explained in the proof. Finite checks supplement rather than prove the infinite-dimensional-index family. Originality is qualified by search coverage.
scientific_limitations: Dyadic Walsh–Hadamard orders at least eight, one sign change, complex matrix operator-norm Schur multipliers only; previously tabulated order-four case is excluded from the novelty assertion; possible uncatalogued equivalent statements in older matrix factorization literature.
title: Exact Schur norms of Walsh–Hadamard matrices with one sign defect
